title: Guided reading: Mark 2:5
subtitle: Read a narrative response and direct speech.
overview: Mark 2:5 combines a narrator’s participial observation with a direct declaration. Keep the narrator’s verb and Jesus’ speech distinct.
Use the article–participle phrase to identify the people whose faith is being observed.

items.grc: καὶ ἰδὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τὴν πίστιν αὐτῶν λέγει τῷ παραλυτικῷ.
items.en: And Jesus, seeing their faith, says to the paralytic.
